The idea

A hash function maps a key to one of mmm slots, so with nnn keys the load factor is

α=nm\alpha = \frac{n}{m}α=mn​
  1. Hash the key with h(k).
  2. Look in slot h(k) mod mh(k) \bmod mh(k)modm:
    • found, or
    • probe the next one.
python
def slot(key, m):
    return hash(key) % m
